balls.text: gone!! Rashid gets Green off the last ball. KKR are bowled out for 180. Rashid threw this on a length, and pretty wide of off. Green went reaching out and slashing, but got a top edge to Buttler

Green is beaten, and so is Buttler - again!! It's byes, and four bonus runs for KKR. Buttler is perhaps blinded by Green advancing, as the ball dips to pitch very full outside leg. Green looks to whip but misses
a googly, and Arora manages a leg bye. Short of a length on middle, and hits his pad as he looks to clip. The ball dribbles to short fine leg
Oh, he takes the single with three balls left. Very full on middle, and he skips and drives to long-on
beaten again!! This time Green aims for the loft down the ground, but the ball is full and wide off, as it turns away
looks for the reverse swat, but is beaten. On a length, and wide-ish of off. The ball turns away to beat Green
a single to keep strike. A low full toss just outside off, and driven to long-on
ohh, Green survives again!! He looks to scoop this low full toss outside leg, and the ball popped up between Buttler and point
amazing bowling. He sees Green advancing, and fires a full and straight ball at 143kph. Green is yorked, and jams his bat for the ball to trickle to short fine leg
nearly a yorker, and swinging into leg. Whipped to short fine leg off the inside half of the bat

and Tyagi is run-out!! Green simply looks down and takes off, and makes it to the keeper's end. By then, though, Tyagi has missed his attempted clip at this inswinging yorker which arrives outside leg. Buttler is alert to Tyagi remaining rooted at the crease, and throws the ball back to Prasidh, who clips the bails off at his end
lovely ball. This ball swings in nicely, and lands as a yorker outside leg at 143kph. Green ends up flicking it off the inside half of the bat to short fine leg's left
amazing!! Tyagi swat-pulls for six over midwicket to stun Siraj and the rest of GT fans. It's a bouncer just around off, and he pulls using his bottom hand to dump the ball for six
short delivery, and beaten. Siraj digs it outside off, and Tyagi sways out of the way by taking his eyes off
shorter side of a length just outside off, and driven back

well taken by Phillips - the best man on the park!! He was at wide backward point, if ever there was such a position. And he moved well to his left, and ended up close to deep-backward point, all the while keeping his eyes on the ball. He slid and completed the catch, as Narine went for a slice off this fullish ball around off
a short ball directed again at Narine. Siraj bangs it on leg at 140kph, and Narine sways out of the way
very full, and swinging into middle. Flicked to fine leg
too short, and on the stumps. The ball shaped away, and Narine missed his attempted swat
now a yorker, and Narine is beaten again. This ball angles across, and lands just outside off at 150kph. Narine has a drive but misses
beaten for pace. Narine makes room, and has a flash. But the ball is short and sharp on leg, and goes over his bat

taken at long-on!! Ashok gets one off the slower ball again. And the fielder, yet again, is Siraj. Ashok floats this at just 105kph, and goes on a length around sixth or seventh stump. Raman can't wait for the ball to arrive, and has a huge heave at it to go across the line. He ends up ballooning the ball for Siraj, who's at long-on, and gets across to his right to grab it

utilises the pace and bounce to pull between the keeper and the man at short fine leg. Shorter still from Ashok, who bowls around sixth stump. Raman is across again, and pulls. The ball seemed to have hit a hard object on its way to the boundary. Yup, it was the helmet. So the physio comes out for the mandatory concussion check
but it doesn't matter for KKR. Short in length from Ashok, and wide of off. Raman goes back and across, and slashes over point
clips this aerially towards square leg, as he gets across at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off
on a fullish length, and just outside off. He gets across, and pushes to deep midwicket for two
short in length, and just outside off. Nudged to midwicket
the ball finishes on leg, and Raman swipes for six. Short of a length on off, but ending on leg, as he swung with the line to go over the straightish fine leg region
leading edge to Rabada's left. Raman looks to nudge at this shortish ball pitching on middle and off, and seaming in, but plays early

a faint outside edge again, and Rinku is done. Buttler and Rabada went up as soon as the ball left the bat. It was on a short of a length just outside off, even as the ball shaped away a little. Rinku went lofting but his front foot was around middle or leg. So he ended up playing away from his body, and got a thin edge
angling across, and landing on a length around fifth stump. Rinku slices it aerially to deep point

Wow, Prasidh and co, and the umpire, heard an outside edge, leaving me confused!! There's a reason why I'm not an umpire!! Short of a length from Prasidh, and on off at 142kph. The ball seams away, and Anukul looks to loft hard. But the ball takes a thin outside edge to Buttler, and Prasidh is pumped up before the umpire raises his finger
another low full toss, and this meets the bottom of the bat around off. Green flicks to deep midwicket
wide just outside leg. Prasidh bowls a yorker, but this arrives just wide of leg. Green looked to clip but missed
another attempted yorker, I think? Prasidh ends up bowling a low full toss on middle and off, and Green clips it hard to beat long-on to his right
short in length, and on the stumps. Anukul guides it to deep third after standing on leg
good pace and length. Prasidh swings the ball in at 141kph, and bowls very full on off. Whipped to long-on by Green
another confident sweep, but only for a single this time. Full and fast, and on off. Swept to deep midwicket's right
very full, and just outside off. Green jams it back down to long-on, and takes two hurriedly
fullish and slower, and just outside off. Green has a hoick, but gets a bottom edge back to Rsahid
Washy drops Green!! Green slog sweeps this full ball to deep-backward square leg, as Washy moves to his left and puts the ball down. The ball drops off and trickles to the boundary

ohhh, more luck for Green!! Rashid beats him convincingly, but Green ends up getting four. I thought there was no outside edge as Green skipped down and looked to loft this length ball turning away. But he ended up getting four just past Buttler
six more!! Green is taking Rashid apart. This time he gets his front leg out of the way, and clatters this full ball on the stumps over midwicket
short of a length, and hurries on to him at 147kph around fifth stump. Pulled to deep midwicket
another slower delivery, and Green gets to fifty. What a relief!! Short in length on off, and nudged to deep square leg
over wide long-on!! "Century?", asks my colleague Abhijato. Green advances, and mows at this slower ball at a short of a length around off

too much bounce, but wide not called. KKR review, though. The first replay shows the ball going over Green's bat, glove and helmet. It was another bouncer from Ashok, as the ball took off from around off. Yup, it's a wide, as the ball goes above Green's head. Wide given

bang on the car on display!! Coming into form could come at a price?! Slower ball from Ashok, but on a hittable, good length on off. Green swings across the line, and gets it off the inside half of the bat. The ball still flies over deep-backward square leg
another tight run. Short in length on middle, and punched to short midwicket
short of a length on odd, and a late dab to deep third. But, but... while Prasidh moved to his left to cut it off, Anukul pushed for two and got it. The throw arrived, but not in time
another googly, and another boundary. Green on the attack. Short of a length from Rashid, and pulled from the stumps right between the men at deep-backward square leg and deep midwicket
bam!! He skips down the pitch, and authoritatively smacks Rashid over long-on. It was a length delivery pitching around sixth stump, and the ball turned in, but Green read that extremely well
a low full toss dipping on middle, and dragged to long-on
goes over extra cover. He takes the inside-out route off this full ball dipping on middle and off, and turning away
short of a length on off, and pushed to cover

confident appeal for lbw from Rashid, but turned down. I thought the impact was just outside off. But I'm not GT's captain. Gill reviews. Green went to sweep at this full delivery, and missed. There's no bat involved, as the third umpire has confirmed. The ball went below Green's bat there, and he has a friendly chat with Rashid while the third umpire is busy. Oh, the impact is indeed outside off. A length ball outside off from Rashid, as the ball straightened. Meanwhile, the batters got a leg bye as the ball dribbled away to the leg side

from 146kph to 107kph - and a wicket arrives. From the back of the hand from Ashok, who bowls on ten shorter side of a length just outside off. Powell has a big heave by reaching out - he may have been beaten by the lack of pace - and ends up skying the ball really high. Siraj, from long-on, does well to concentrate and keep his eye on it as he moves forward. He ends up taking it a good few steps forward
a wide this time. Too high from Ashok. He fires a bouncer at 146kph, but this pitches around off, and Powell sways out

this lands between two fielders. More fortune goes Green's way. Slower ball, and fullish and wide of off. Green has a slash, and mistimes it, as the ball lands between deep point running in and point turning around running forward
another bouncer. Green looks to pull but despite his height, the ball goes over his bat

some luck for Green - and he needs that too, you'd think. An inside edge goes past the stumps, and beats the man at short fine leg. A short-of-a-length ball just outside off, and Green hoicks across the line but doesn't connect cleanly
a bouncer, and Green is beaten. Ashok bangs this on or around off at 143kph, and the ball goes over Green's bat as he looks to pull
ohh, this lands outside the pitch on the off side. The length was full, and the ball was swinging away. Green let it go, and it's called no-ball
an inswinging yorker at 145kph. Ashok lands it bang on the base of off, and Green digs it out safely
Steps back and tries to launch this one into the ropes. But only gets an edge to this length ball, on the stumps, down to long leg
Full and well outside off, Green uses those longggg arms for an impeccable sweep! Drags this from outside off, on one knee, and towards an empty deep midwicket
On a length, on the stumps. Green defends this right back to Rashid
Full-ish and on the stumps still. But spins down leg side, so needs to reload
Full and on the stumps to the tall Green, who bends a little as he flicks this towards mid-wicket
Pulls back the length, Powell goes for another sweep. Can't quite place this one, flies up in the air and goes down towards fine leg
Powell plays this sweep with finesse! Lands on a leg stump line, quite full, Powell gets down on one knee and glides this sweep quite fine, towards deep fine leg
Low full toss just outside off, Green hits it towards long-on across the line. Comes back for the second run with ease
Green almost loses his balance! Somehow plays this out to deep square leg. Prasidh spears this in around 146 clicks; on the stumps and right in front of the pads
Mistimes this lofted drive but falls short of deep cover. Was fuller and outside off, moving in too. Powell puts his back into that lofted drive but just couldn't get under it
On a length outside off, good pace on this. Powell plays this late but without much power, towards backward point
Prasidh puts in a huge appeal! The ball landed quite full, right in front of the pads. Green missed this, it looked like, ran to the other end anyway. Umpire not interested. Gill neither.

And now Green bunts this one over cow corner! Back of a length, moving into him. He swings across the line and while he doesn't time it perfectly, he's picked the gap perfectly. No fielder there. One bounce, over the ropes
Goes for a late cut once more. On a similar length, moving away from Powell outside off, but straight to the fielder at backward point
Another full-blooded strike here. On a length but gives too much width outside off, and it just runs away to the deep point boundary
Now Powell connects with this one, and oof, so well! Was a little short, rising right at his chest. He swivels at this and deposits this well over the deep midwicket ropes
Powell goes for a huge hoick! But the ball is just inside-edged into... his pads right below him
On a great length, moving in again. Phillips with a worldly of a save at mid-off. Driven right down to Phillips, who pulls off a dramatic dive to save at least two runs
Back of a length and tailing into Green, who bunts this down the pitch and takes off to the other end
On a length, on the stumps, and flicked down to deep midwicket
Powell sends this over the cow corner boundary! Too full and right in Powell's arc, targeting the stumps and Powell lofts this over the ropes with ease. Checks the drive, good posture

Oh lord. Powell defends this length ball from in front of the stumps, defends it back to Prasidh. Hangs around the crease and Prasidh sends a message by throwing this back at the stumps. Misses by a few miles though, back to the keeper
Big appeal but hit Powell too high on the pads, maybe drifting down leg too! Swung back in just slightly after landing full-ish and on the stumps
Full and kept outside off, Green leans back to drive this towards deep cover
On a length but drifting down leg. Prasidh has to reload
A mistimed loft towards deep cover. Lands just short of him even as the fielder runs in. The ball was kept outside off, swinging away, and hence Powell couldn't quite middle this
Great ball, once more! Pushed fuller, swinging into the stumps. Defense off the middle of the bat and back to Rabada
Rinse, repeat... Another ball dangled outside off, swinging away. Green goes for a swish and misses once more... A more in-form batter might have edged one of these by now
On a length and moving into Green, defended from right under his eyes. Dribbles down to backward point
Short and outside off. Powell stays in his crease to tuck this one towards deep backward point
Kept well outside off, reaches away from the body to this length ball but just drifts past him too
Rabada begins his third on the trot with an appeal! Straight and full, hits him on the pads. But drifting down leg...
Less ambitious with a tuck towards the covers. Outside off on a length, he plays a checked drive, and it runs past the covers fielders, and he runs to the other end
Another swish from outside off. Nothing but air on this, and he's making a habit of it in this innings...

A venomous bouncer and Green might have edged this one! Bounced this outside leg, tails in towards Green's head, then away from it. He swivels at this, Siraj goes for a big appeal... Cam Green asks for a review. But the DRS says there's no edge. Not out it is
Another away swinger. Fuller and attacking the stumps, Powell goes for another defense and sees an edge dribble along the ground, past backward point
Beauty! Swings away from Powell after landing on a length, just outside off. Tentative defense at this and it just tails away from him. Lucky to not nick this one
On a length outside off, Green pats this towards point and sets off for a run

Bashed straight to Phillips at cover! What have you done, Seifert? Was a nothing ball, really, outside off and lots of width off a good length. But the ball died just a little with its bounce off the pitch. Seifert reaches for the cut and times it to perfection. Perfectly to Phillips, that is...
Another late edge, dribbles down to deep backward point. Ball landed shorter, outside off, Green didn't move his feet much as he just poked at this one
Seifert throws his bat at this one outside off! Flew off the edge towards deep backward point. Was too full to get under the ball, really
Pulls the length a little back, still on that leg side line. Tucked towards silly mid-on and sets off for a leg bye
Rabada bowls this fuller and closer to his pads now. Drive down the ground, mid-on collects

Solid drive through cover and extra cover. The outfield is lightning quick and it runs away to the ropes. Was on a good length, outside off, but enough width for Seifert to stand tall and hit this from deep inside his crease
A late poke to this ball on a length, outside off. Dribbles down to backward point. Green starts running to the other end but he aborts that

Green connects, but superb fielding from deep backward point - Ashok Sharma - to save two runs. Was hung outside off, Green steps down the ground and drives this towards the ropes. Not the best timing though
Green goes for a big waft outside off, on a length. Swishes at air once more... Smart bowling to tempt him in the challenge with swing still in the offer
Misfield lets Seifert get off strike! Outside off, on a good length, Seifert drives this towards the covers, who just lets this burst through his hands. Gill the fielder
Closer to the stumps now, on a length - 136 clicks - and angling into the batter. He semi-deadbats this into the ground and looks for a run. Won't take off
Goes for a huge swing down the ground! Kept on a length, outside off. Gets nothing but air on it

A peach from Rabada rips out Raghuvanshi! Was on a good length, and then swings away just a little from outside off. Raghuvanshi goes for a tentative poke away from his body and edges this to the keeper
Full but drifting down leg side. Time to reload
Edge dribbles down to deep backward point! Was a quick ball, even quicker off Raghuvanshi's cut. But he got an edge on this and it runs to the ropes, despite a valiant diving effort from Siraj
Now Rabada goes fuller, on the pads. Flicked towards mid-wicket
He's swung through the line and middled this one, depositing it over cow corner! Back of a length and angling into Seifert once more. He has all the room he needs to swivel pull this
Rabada is finding some good bounce here. Kept this well outside off, Seifert jumped at this with a waft, swishing at only air
Great ball! Venom on this as Rabada pushes this back of a length, just outside off. It angles into Seifert and hits him close to his chest, who is rushed more than he expected
Punches this one to deep point! Siraj goes fuller, closer to the stumps. Raghuvanshi throws his hands at this late and just rifles this between point and backward point
On a length, kept well outside off and swings away. Raghuvanshi happy to let this one go

Rahane's gone for it, and consequently, he's gone.. The ball was full and right outside off. Rahane goes for a lofted drive right down the ground. Except he doesn't middle this - the swing got the better of him - so there's a top edge that looms in the air forever, then lands right in Rabada's hands near mid-on
Fuller and closer to the stumps. Seifert still in the crease, then he drives it down to mid-off
Gives him width this time and Seifert bashes this down to deep extra cover! Back of a length, but enough width for Seifert to hit this through the line
On a length outside off, decent swing away. Seifert happy to begin with a forward defense

GT win after making themselves and their fans nervous!! Shahrukh gets a short delivery outside off, and he swats that forcefully to go wide of long-off. Powell does well to tumble and save a four, but that's certainly not enough
a leading edge... but safe. He looks to clip this full ball on middle, but ends up playing too early. A single to extra cover, where Rahane is deep in the circle
short delivery again, but at a lack pf pace. Shahrukh gets on top of the bounce to dab it to deep third

got him!! Is there drama left yet?! Phillips finds Rinku at deep midwicket. Short delivery from Raman, and slightly wide of off. Phillips opens his stance and goes for the pull by looking to ride the bounce, only for him to get off the top half of the bat
on a length, and wide outside off. Left alone by Phillips
driven hard to deep cover. Full delivery around fifth stump, and he throws his bat hard at it
no timing on the pull from Tewatia. The ball drops where a midwicket fielder would've been. Short ball zipping through on off, and Tewatia mistimes his shot
good, consistent length, but it could be too late. A low full toss on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket
an attempted yorker around sixth stump, and squeezed back to Arora's right for a dot
low full toss angling into off, and swiped to fine leg

great attempt by Tyagi to stop it at fine leg, but it's four two. Tewatia whipped this full ball angling into middle, and played it behind square. Tyagi ran and dived to his left, but touched the boundary cushion even after slightly bringing the ball to a halt. The fielder backing up, Narine, picked the ball up to throw it back. But the ball may have already touched the boundary by then. The third umpire is checking multiple times to confirm. This looks tricky: was the ball stopped cleanly before Tyagi ran into the cushion? Did Narine pick it up before it touched the cushion? Was the cushion pushed back as Tyagi slid to his left? It's taking a lot of time to confirm. Wow, it's given as two only
he shapes to pull, but seeing the ball is on a short of a length just outside off, he slashes it deep point
this skids through off a length, and finishes on his pads. Swiped towards fine leg
cleverly played. A roll of the wrists to beat short fine leg to his left. Slower bouncer from Tyagi, who bowls wide of off. Phillips reads it well, and pulls it late for another four
lofted down the ground. The non-striker has to duck to let the ball pass. Full delivery in the slot on off, and Phillips bashes it back with a high left elbow while being deep in the crease
shorter side of a length on off, and pushed to mid-off for a hurried single
shortish in length on off, and punched to long-off

amazing catch by Green!! Gill falls on 86 after a tumbling take by the tallest man on the field. Green is at deep third, and he moves and dives forward to take it barely off the ground. Gill walks off livid with himself. Arora kept firing it full and a little wide of off, and this time Gill couldn't find the gap. He went slicing to go through the line, and sliced it aerially to deep third. A shorter fielder there, and you think Gill may have survived
wide ball. Too wide outside off from Arora, who bowls it on the fuller side. Left alone by Gill
very full, and on off. Whipped to wide mid-on
slashed to deep third. Green runs to his right to cut this off, but by then, Phillips has picked two. Full ball angling across to arrive wide-ish of off, and Phillips swings at it
on the bounce to Rinku, who now moves forward from deep cover point. Full ball outside off, and Gill slices aerially at it

a repeat of the last ball, but this time Gill executes. The ball is full and wide of off, and Gill lofts it to deep extra cover. The ball falls just short of Rinku, who runs to his right from deep point
angles it across, and bowls full around sixth stump. Gill has a drive at it, but is beaten
fullish and slower. Gill nudges it gently towards square leg
this keeps low off a full length, as the ball skids through. It arrives on middle, and Phillips gets it off the outside half of the bat to cover point
half a step down, and flicks this length ball on the stumps to deep midwicket
short again, but this is finishing on leg. Clipped to deep square leg
another dot ball. Phillips punched this short ball back, and the ball deflected off Anukul to go to his right
Seifert appeals for caught behind, but it's called wide. Full and angling in, but pitching outside leg. Phillips went sweeping, but missed
bowls full and fast on off. Clipped to the man close in at midwicket
short and quick, and on the stumps. Again Phillips clips to deep square leg
fullish ball just outside leg. No turn for Varun, and Gill tickles it to fine leg
on a length on middle, and turning in. Nudged to deep-backward square leg

finds fine leg!! A wicket out of nowhere, you'd think. Washy looked in control in his brief outing so far, but this time pulls straight to the fielder. Varun angles this in, and bowls short at Washy again. Washy goes ahead with the pull, but doesn't clear the boundary
on a length, and just outside leg. Tucked to fine leg
bowls short on leg, and the ball turns away. Pulled to deep square leg after opening his stance up
slower ball. On a length on middle, and swiped to deep midwicket to cap off an expensive over for KKR
wide outside leg. Another short ball, but this wide of leg. Washy looks to pull by reaching out, but misses
just past the tumbling Seifert. Short delivery on leg, and Washy looks to pull. He manages a glove to beat Seifert to his right, even as he's late on the shot
change of pace from Tyagi. He bowls short again, though, and Gill swat-pulls this ball from just outside off to deep midwicket
lovely hit!! What a sound off the bat. Almost a no-look pull. Short ball on middle and off, and Gill deposits it over deep square leg with a short-arm pull
shorter side of a length, but again on leg. Takes Washy's pads as he looks to clip. The ball dribbles to fine leg for a leg bye
fullish ball floated on leg, and whipped to deep midwicket. The man at deep square chases to his right
fuller and slower, and around fifth stump. Slashed to cover, as Narine is done
on the shorter side of a length, and driven back to Narine
on the shorter side of a length on middle, and again turns away. Punched to long-off
short of a length on the stumps, and quicker too. Punched to long-on, as GT look to see Narine off
on a length on leg, and turning away to finish on off. Pushed to long-on to keep ticking
Gill steps out, and drives at what is now a length ball on middle and off. Single to long-off
on a length, and much quicker. Slashed to deep point from off
bang!! The ball flies down the ground. He spots this full and tossed-up ball dipping just outside off, and launches it over Varun's head
much slower, and fuller ball just outside off. Pushed towards mid-on
just over the man at point. Gill goes for the cut, and plays aerially, but survives. Short of a length from Varun, and Gill plays after the ball turns away to finish outside off
much fuller ball, and driven from around middle and off to wide long-off, as Gill makes room. Two more for Gill
he takes a step down, and Varun bowls short on middle. Gill ends up pushing it down towards deep midwicket, and pushes for two
on a length on middle and off, and punched to deep midwicket
slashed to point. Short in length, and played from the stump-to-stump line
full again, and on off. Turning in, and clipped wide of long-on
a late cut for a single to deep point, although Washy sends Gill back after an attempted second. Short of a length, and just outside off, as Washy cuts Narine away
on a fullish length on leg, and turning away to finish just outside off. Pushed back to Narine
full and straight, and flicked to deep midwicket. Fifty for Gill off 27 balls - don't miss his capless/helmetless raise of the bat
Fuller and spinning into Gill. He flicks it late towards fine leg, and takes off for the other end
And now to the left-hander, he bowls in the outside off line. Flicked towards mid-on with ease though
He's found a much better line here. On a length and spinning away from Gill, who bunts this towards point and takes off
Back of a length and spinning in from outside off once more, flicked towards square leg
Gets down the pitch and plays a late cut, but it's a thick edge, and goes to fine leg on the bounce. Was back of a length and spinning into him from a sixth stump line

VC has got 'is man! Floated this in a little too full, but maybe it played in his favour. Buttler goes for the cross-batted hoick towards long-on. But the googly meant Buttler misread both the line as well as his ability to get under this delivery. Hits it too flat and finds the fielder
Well outside off and a little too full. Buttler reaches for this to play a fine inside-out drive, and gets it towards deep cover
Bangs this one in on a short length, and razes Buttler's shoulder as it rushes to the keeper. Buttler took his eyes off the ball while trying to pull this one
Back of a length and coming into Buttler's pads. He rises on his toes to flick this towards mid-on

And now Gill pulls this from well outside off - rising at him from back of a length - towards cow corner. Great timing with that classic pull of his, with barely any movement besides his forearms locking into the shot
Tries to glide this late. Rising at him from outside off, back of a length. But finds the fielder at point
Saved four runs at covers! Driven from a full length outside off, saved by Rahane
VC has pulled back his length here. He bunts this drive softly, past mid-on
full and on the leg side line, flicked towards mid-wicket
On a length, outside off. He flicks this towards square leg and sets off for the other end
Outside off, and he plays this softly - from a good length - towards point
On a length, spinning back into the pads so Buttler gets caught up in a tangle while looking to play off the backfoot
Now Buttler takes off one hand off the handle, as if to just say he can! Varun goes way too full, right outside off, and Buttler hammers this down the pitch with disdain

How has he played it so fine from that position? The ball was wellll outside off, barely any spin on it. Gill adjusts his wrists to almost play this as the ball is passing him by, and somehow glides it between backward point and fly slip
On a length and drifting into the leg side, flicked towards mid-wicket
On a length, spinning into him. Flick towards cow corner
Gill has a bit of Viv Richards in this one! Well outside off, a little too full, so he lofts this right into the covers boundary. All aura right now
On a length again, right in front of the stumps, so tucked away towards backward square leg
On a length, Gill - helmetless now! - just bunts this down to mid-on

It's beaten Seifert! Spins back into Buttler, who is on the backfoot looking to just play this down the ground. Carrom ball spins in extravagantly, hits his edge, and Seifert is nowhere close to that ball to take the catch
Bowls quicker, 98.4 clicks, and turns away from Buttler. Defends this down the pitch

In the slot once more, and now Buttler deposits this over long-off! Buttler is not hanging around against Narine, takes some will to pull that off. Carrom ball outside off, but right in the slot for him
On a length and spinning back in, Gill cuts this quite late towards deep point
Narine goes too full and well outside off. Buttler's eyes light up as he sees this land in the slot, so he treats it like vintage Buttler always has: lofted drive towards deep extra cover
Sudharsan tries to pull this one, but it's on the leg stump line and cramps him midway through that shot. He has to hunch to hit that from quite low, and it's gone straight to backward square leg
Short ball once more, outside off and all the time in the world for Gill to sit back and counter this. Pulled across the line, towards deep midwicket

Back of a length and rising right at Gill, who hoicks this but cannot time it from that angle down his leg side. Caught his glove and towards Kartik Tyagi at fine leg, except he can't dive for the ball in time
Stuck in the pitch, back of a length and swinging away from Sudharsan outside off. He hits this back into the turf while looking to hit it down the ground
Travels into the leg side once more. Now Vaibhav fires it in, angled towards his hips, so he has to be content with another cramped delivery being boshed towards cow corner
Well, how do you even praise this one? In the slot right on the stumps. Slower ball, 108 clicks, Gill just lofts this down the ground with a lofted drive. Simply sumptuous
Gill shuffles deeeep into the leg side, but Vaibhav cramps him for room by bowling this back of a length and on the stumps. He swishes at air with his cut
Drifting down leg once more, but the fielder placed at backward square leg for that exact flick.
Outside off, and cut late to covers
Pushed slightly fuller, coming into the batter from that awkward leg stump line. Tries to defend it but gets into a tangle
Carrom ball but long hop. Sudharsan goes back in his crease and plays a full-muscled sweep towards the deep square leg boundary. There to be hit and he did
On a length, he plays this late towards fine leg. Cannot buy a run from that one
Narine begins by spinning this into Gill. Carrom ball, from just outside off, from a good length, and into Gill. Thick edge down to mid-wicket
Yes, indeed, that's why he's opening with Gill! In the slot, poor ball, and in front of the stumps. Sudharsan just stands absolutely still and plays a drive across the line. Lofts this over long-on
Anukul goes fuller once more, outside off, in response. Dug out towards point

And now Sudharsan reminds us we shouldn't just be raving about his partner! This ball was fine once more. A little full, if anything, and dragged well down leg side. Sudharsan is down on his knees in a jiffy and plays a late loft, over deep backward point
Speared in quite full, practically in the blockhole in front of the stumps. Gill digs it out and gets it towards the covers anyway, making it look elegant as only he can with these small touches

And now an otherworldly lofted inside-out drive! He steps down the pitch to convert this perfectly okay good length delivery on the stumps. He lofts it over deep extra cover. How did he even get it into the off side off the angle?
Quite full and outside off, he flicks this with ease towards mid-wicket
Get the photographers going, won't you? Barely moves as the ball finds its way to the slot outside off once more. He plays a minimalist straight drive, runs down the ground as if drawn with a ruler
And now he places it perfectly! The ball was a little wider, and dropped shorter too. Gill lofted this over the covers, uppish but completely safe. Runs away to the boundary
Another perfect ping! But straight to extra cover this time. Was there to be driven outside off, but Gill couldn't place it as well as he timed it
Speared in quite full on the stumps once more. Flicks this towards mid-wicket, where Sunil Narine chases the ball going past him and holds it back from the ropes. 150 kph, by the way!
Full-ish and outside off. Sudharsan stays deep in his crease and defends this down the pitch
A low full toss, a ramrod straight drive from Sudharsan. On the bounce straight to Tyagi, who puts out one hand but can't stop it completely
Outside leg but tailing back into the left-hander. Flicks this off a good length and towards square leg
Pulls the length back just a little, he flicks this towards deep fine leg and sets off for an easy run
Absolutely boshes this through the covers! What a drive: outside off, in the slot, so he keeps his head still and just clobbers it through the gap
Flicks this ball, but it shapes in from a full-ish line, and it rises in the air! Crucially it is placed near the empty square leg region, so his mistime doesn't cost him much
Pulls back his length, on a fifth stump line. Gill happy to shoulder arms to this one
On a good length but on leg stump, Sudharsan eases a flick towards backward point. Misses the shot, in fact, so a leg bye
